page.layout: One page of text: a dedication heading in the upper right, set in capitals and roman type with a line-end hyphen, followed by a signature line in italic on the right. Two woodcut ornaments (above the heading and in the lower centre). No margin notes, running head, page number or catchword.

main_text.head: DIGNITATE, DOCTRI-na, Genere Nobilis. & Clariss. Viro, D. SEBALDO VVELSERO, Senatori Norico, amico ac Do-mino in primis observando,

page.notes: The hyphen after "DOCTRI" is printed as a mark close to a semicolon; it is read as a line-end hyphen, but this is uncertain. The ornaments, the library stamp in the centre, the handwritten shelf mark at top right and the ghosted show-through of the reverse side (large "DE ... " letters at top right and faint text lower right) are omitted. The signature line is set as a paragraph, not a heading.
